title: Choose Concise’s visual world — fresh hand
question: This hand explores new territory. Choose a direction, re-roll again, or steer safer or bolder.

options.label: Typesetter’s Galley
options.lineage: composing sticks, proof galleys, and movable type
options.thesis: Each file is a live proof assembled on one precise galley, with adjustments set directly into its measure.
options.viewport: A large media proof occupies the galley while a narrow measure rail sets crop, dimensions, quality, and output in one vertical rhythm.
options.risk: It can feel literary or print-bound unless motion and media previews keep the language contemporary.

raised.raise: The active proof is brighter and still while inactive tools recede by depth, never by extra boxes.
The route from source to export remains explicit and every completed state leaves a readable trace.
Dense values align to an exact character grid and keyboard access is first-class.
The user’s media stays dominant while annotations remain quiet, precise, and optional.

options.label: Light Table
options.lineage: photographic contact sheets and illuminated editing tables
options.thesis: The opened file becomes the luminous center of the room, with tools touching its edges and nothing competing with the work.
options.viewport: A bright media surface floats on a dark table with crop handles over the image and a low amber instrument rail beneath it.
options.risk: It is a familiar professional editing metaphor and needs disciplined restraint to avoid resembling existing photo software.

options.label: Signal Queue
options.lineage: cracktro title screens and depth-ranked work queues
options.thesis: One bright line of work holds still in an emissive void while tools and previous states drift behind it by depth.
options.viewport: The filename and Open command sit bright and still across the center while Crop, Resize, Trim, and Convert occupy dimmer receding baselines.
options.case: It strongly identifies with local digital work and makes focus unmistakable, but the single-face void carries less immediate precision than the galley.
options.risk: The scene can read as developer tooling and the dark field may under-serve image comparison.

options.label: Conversion Ticket
options.thesis: A file’s journey is a coupon book: source, adjustment, and export remain visible until the finished stub tears free.
options.viewport: A crisp ticket wallet opens across the screen with the source on the left, live preview in the center, and export stub on the right.
options.case: It makes the workflow exceptionally clear and memorable, but fewer users identify tickets with precise visual editing.
options.risk: Journey language can become a theme layer that competes with direct utility labels.

options.label: Utility Pages
options.thesis: Every tool has a direct three-digit page inside a strict 40-by-24-cell utility magazine.
options.viewport: Page 100 indexes the tools while a large mosaic file preview waits beside direct page numbers.
options.case: Direct addressing is fast, but rigid cells reduce preview fidelity and the language demands prior familiarity.
options.kept: Values and shortcuts should align to an exact keyboard-friendly grid.
options.risk: The broadcast reference can become retro novelty instead of a durable workspace.

options.label: Media Atlas
options.thesis: Each file is a chart plate whose important dimensions, boundaries, and outputs appear as ranked coordinates.
options.viewport: The media fills a coordinate plate with crop bounds and output values plotted quietly around its brightest anchors.
options.case: It gives the preview real dignity, but coordinate navigation overcomplicates a small set of obvious tools.
options.kept: The media should dominate while technical annotations remain quiet and optional.
options.risk: A beautiful map is still the wrong interaction model for quick file busywork.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A centered upload area opens into a clean conventional media editor.
canonCard.viewport: A centered headline and dashed dropzone sit above a grid of utility shortcuts.
canonCard.risk: Highly familiar, but indistinguishable from the file-tool sites Concise is meant to replace.
